title: Reset Password
content: Open the login page, select Forgot Password, and follow the email reset link.

title: Account Locked
content: Wait 15 minutes after repeated failed login attempts, then reset your password if needed.

title: Failed Payment
content: Check the transaction status. If payment was deducted but the order failed, verify the transaction and process a refund if needed.

title: Payment Pending
content: Allow up to 24 hours for a pending payment to update. If it remains pending, contact the payment provider.

title: App Crashing
content: Restart the application, clear its cache, and install the latest available update.

title: Update Account Details
content: Open Account Settings to update your profile information. Contact support if changes cannot be saved.

title: Slow Application
content: Check your internet connection, restart the app, and retry. If the issue continues, report the device and app version.

title: Incorrect Account Details
content: Verify the registered email address and phone number in Account Settings. Contact support to correct details you cannot edit.
